_doc: Hand-maintained key dates marked on vital charts and listed in the timeline. Each event lists which indicators it annotates. Keep each event dated and sourced. Reviewed with the infrastructure checklist.

events.label: Birr floated
events.detail: The National Bank of Ethiopia moved to a market-based exchange rate, part of an IMF programme. The official birr/USD rate jumped sharply.

events.label: GERD inaugurated
events.detail: The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam was inaugurated at its full 5,150 MW capacity.

events.label: Red Sea shipping disrupted
events.detail: Attacks on shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb strait from late 2023 cut transit volumes through the Red Sea, raising freight costs on Ethiopia's main trade route.

events.label: GERD first power
events.detail: The first GERD turbine began generating electricity.
